topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Just found out my apartment building is flipping to condos. Fantastic. Like my life needed more uncertainty. Now, I get to dodge emails and meetings from some developer trying to sell me a unit I can't afford. Meanwhile, rent hikes loom, and the cozy place I called home morphs into a showroom. I’m not sure what’s more thrilling: the prospect of being priced out or dealing with the parade of potential buyers traipsing through my space. If they think for a second I’m going to be the one to decorate for an open house, they’ve got another thing coming.
